dataset.name: EgoLife
dataset.license_or_access_note: EgoLife is released under S-Lab License 1.0 for non-commercial research. Only a targeted consecutive 60-second excerpt is stored locally. Released frames have identifiable faces blurred. Captions and private dialogue are not used and are not committed.

screening_batch.purpose: Same-source appearance-matched second coffee corner and separately purchased compatible refills; no unreadable source commercial size.
screening_batch.authoring_rule: Explicitly reuse the complete original two-query window; historical task and evidence remain unchanged.

observed_events.description: A separate black brewing dripper is placed on an existing glass jug. No brand, commercial size or exact base geometry is readable.
The wearer handles and opens a white paper filter. These oblique frames are not used to adjudicate a pointed V60 base against a wedge-bottom paper family.
Paper is seated inside the separate dripper and grounds are added. This supports the paper-filter brewing activity, not an exact retail family or cup size.

visual_review.scope_limit: Two official 30-second slices covering 12:40:00-12:41:00 were concatenated into one continuous excerpt and inspected through ordered samples plus the eight released frames. This is not uninterrupted native-rate playback of a longer hour file. DAY5/DAY7 video and the Jake view were not locally available.
visual_review.face_blur: The stored source excerpt and every released frame have the wearer lower-face region and the second person on the right Gaussian-blurred. Brand and dripper size remain unreadable.

targeted_repair_scope_20261018.scope: Prior 1–31s ordered 2fps/11–22s folding inspection is reused only for the separate dripper, glass jug and paper handling. This repair did not claim native-fps playback or resolve pointed versus wedge geometry.

color_matching_repair_20261018.observation: The main dripper body is consistently black; the final white liner is separate paper. No commercial model, paper size, precise geometry or new continuous-video claim is made.

screening_lineage.discovery_method: Targeted EgoLife DAY4 pour-over excerpt after a prior dependency gap that existing catalogs lacked a real dripper-filter compatibility family.
screening_lineage.same_event_views: DAY4 Jake and Shure views are one source event. Only the Shure excerpt is stored locally.
screening_lineage.additional_sources_pending: DAY5 and DAY7 pour-over video was not locally available without a full EgoLife download.

unsupported_claims: The dripper brand, model or commercial size is readable.
The paper filter SKU, bleached vs unbleached colour, or pack count is established.
The source records an authored shopping request or spoken brand name.
Full native-frame-rate playback of an hour-long EgoLife file was watched.
The released oblique paper view uniquely establishes V60 pointed rather than wedge-bottom paper geometry.

instruction_freeze.rule: Keep all81 captured entities and the8 original frames. Frame color is necessary; public compatibility, not source commercial paper family, determines the separately bought pack.

screening.before: A second standalone dripper with a black main body, matching the visible component's color, no extra jug, and compatible disposable paper available in the frozen window.
screening.later_information: Also buy one separately listed compatible paper pack; do not remove the chosen dripper.
screening.after: Keep one same-color dripper and add one separately sold pack publicly listed as compatible with it; included paper does not replace this extra pack.
screening.real_user_need: Equip another coffee corner using an already owned jug, keep the same visible component color for a coordinated look, then add a separate refill pack.

supported_claims.text: The separate dripper above the glass jug has a black main body in released V0:0/4/7. Paper and grounds establish its brewing role. A second coffee corner can match this visible color without copying an unreadable retail model or paper geometry.

unsupported_claims: The source records the authored shopping request.
Exact brand, model or filter size of the observed objects.
Full native-frame-rate source playback was watched.
The source uniquely proves a pointed V60 rather than wedge-bottom commercial paper family.

construct.research_question: Can the agent match the visible component's color for another coffee corner, preserve its valid choice, and add a publicly compatible paper pack?
construct.belief_before: A second standalone dripper with a black main body, matching the visible component's color, no extra jug, and compatible disposable paper available in the frozen window.
construct.belief_after: Keep one same-color dripper and add one separately sold pack publicly listed as compatible with it; included paper does not replace this extra pack.
construct.required_behavior_change: Keep one black-main-body functional brewing component selected under A and add one compatible paper pack under B. Do not infer the source brand, capacity or exact paper geometry.
construct.no_update_failure: Only the dripper remains after the request for a separate refill pack.
construct.overupdate_failure: The dripper is removed, a second jug or third cart entity is added, or only included sample papers are counted.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: A asks for the same color without naming it. Released native V0:0/4/7 show the component's black main body. Text and website alone cannot establish that required color; publicly compatible nonblack setups remain real alternatives but fail the actual same-color need. Glass, metal mesh, material, brand and capacity do not determine color equivalence.

instructions.a: For another coffee corner, I want another of the piece I'm using on top of the glass jug. Keep the same color as the one in front of me so the two corners match. Add that part only; I already have another jug. Any brand or capacity is fine, but choose one with disposable paper refills available here.
instructions.b: Also add one separately sold pack of paper refills listed as compatible with the item you've chosen. Keep that item. Any brand or paper color is fine; paper included with it doesn't replace this extra pack.
instructions.bundled: For another coffee corner, I want another of the piece I'm using on top of the glass jug. Keep the same color as the one in front of me so the two corners match. Add that part only; I already have another jug. Any brand or capacity is fine, but choose one with disposable paper refills available here. Also add one separately sold pack of paper refills listed as compatible with the item you've chosen. Keep that item. Any brand or paper color is fine; paper included with it doesn't replace this extra pack.

task_blueprint.protocol_status: Same-source appearance-matching repair. Native images determine the black main body; public compatibility determines the separate refill. Prior17/145 and7/65 boundaries preserved. Current7/84 applies the same explicit conical/filter-cup class claims consistently; independent confirmation is not claimed by the constructor.

observed.why: B authorizes a separate pack while the valid selected component remains required.

native_state_checks.correct: One black-main-body standalone brewing component plus one separately sold paper pack listed as compatible.
native_state_checks.wrong: A nonblack-main-body component, unestablished refill relation, or added jug.
native_state_checks.missing: Chosen dripper or the separately bought paper pack is absent.
native_state_checks.extra: Third cart entity, second dripper or added jug.
native_state_checks.premature: The separate paper purchase is only authorized by B.
native_state_checks.stale: Only the dripper remains after B.

answer_boundary_repair_20261018.matching_rule: Match the main visible body color, not every trim piece. Black-body portable mesh-bottom components are useful alternatives; paperless means paper is unnecessary, not forbidden. No same-brand/model/material/capacity/source-paper-family condition. For B, accept an explicit named family, an unqualified compatible cone/filter-cup class or universal claim when the chosen component belongs to it. Apply the same class claim to all seven cones; do not infer exclusive family restrictions from a title number. A most-standard/most-cone claim alone leaves particular unlisted relations unsupported.
